text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament adopts law on public financing of political parties.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari received the visiting Libyan Planning, Economy and Trade Minister Abdel Hafidh Zlitni. They discussed the ways of boosting bilateral cooperation.
- Abdallah Amami named as chairman of radio channels and Ridha Methnani named as chairman of TV channels.
- Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi said cooperation in trade with Libya should amounted to 700 million dinars during this year.
- Tunisian ferry Ulysse of Compagnie Tunisienne de Navigation (CTN) inaugurated. ($1= 1.1221 dinar)
